name: State
description: Generic persistent key-value state for agents (session / user / app scope), namespaced per configuration. Use-case-agnostic primitives for memory, dedup, counters, and caching.

tools.name: state_get
tools.documentation: Reads one or more stored values by scope and key (accepts a single key or a list of keys to batch in one call).

tools.name: state_set
tools.documentation: REPLACES one or more values outright, discarding the previous ones; accepts a single key/value or matching lists of keys/values to batch in one call. Use 'user' or 'app' scope to persist across runs. Do not use for 'add'/'also remember' requests — use state_append.

tools.name: state_append
tools.documentation: ADDS one or more values to a list at a key without discarding what's already stored, creating the list if unset; accepts a single value or a list of values to append all at once. Use for 'add'/'also remember'/'append' requests.

tools.name: state_update
tools.documentation: REPLACES one specific item within a list with a new value, in place, leaving the rest untouched; no-op if the old value isn't found. Use for 'update/change/correct X to Y in the list' requests. Do not use state_set for this — it discards the whole list.

tools.name: state_remove
tools.documentation: REMOVES one or more specific values from a list at a key, keeping the rest of the list; accepts a single value or a list of values to remove all at once. Use for 'remove X from the list' requests. Do not use state_delete for this — it erases the whole key.

tools.name: state_delete
tools.documentation: Permanently removes one or more keys and their values entirely within the namespace (accepts a single key or a list of keys to batch in one call). Erases the whole key/list — use state_remove instead to take out just one item.

tools.name: state_keys
tools.documentation: Lists all keys stored under the namespace for a given scope.
